summary: Klamath County, OR: 1934 cabin and 1935 60-ft CCC steel tower for the Klamath Indian Agency; manned into the 1950s; tower removed by 1974; both site listings say gone.

facts.status_note: Both site listings say the tower and cabin are gone; a 1974 lookout summary says the tower was removed and the living quarters cabin remained

corrections.why: Both site listings and the 1967 NGS description give a 60-foot tower (about 18.3 m); 4.9 m (about 16 ft) matches no source

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both site listings say the tower and cabin are gone; the 1974 lookout summary says the tower was removed and the living quarters cabin remained. Recorded as gone, with the 1974 note kept in status_note.
A 1934 plan called for a 47-foot Aermotor tower; the tower built in 1935 was 60 feet per the agency evaluation, the NGS 1967 description and both site listings. Recorded as 60 feet.

notes_for_editor: Most detail comes from the Weebly page, which transcribes 1934-1974 agency reports and newspaper clippings; the originals were not opened. The brief's height_m (4.9) is wrong and is corrected. The cabin's fate conflicts between the 1974 summary and the two site listings. The tower was still described in a 1971 NGS note, so removal falls between 1971 and 1974; the story uses the 1974 summary. Firetower.org photos (Verschoor, Kemnow) have no direct image URLs, so none were added. A search for a current source found nothing new.
